title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1310: Kindred spirits (1)

section.p: “Liu Hong…”
Su Yu muttered as he sank into thought. Was Liu Hong here only to complete a deal with the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion? What could he even offer to the pavilion?

Su Yu considered the question as he rapped on the table with his fingers. When he last saw Liu Hong, that fellow was busy scamming the Invincible descendants in the Human Realm. He sure was lucky to still be alive.

Not only was he alive, but he had even entered the Yellow Index. He had done his reputation as one of the top geniuses of his batch proud. His batch was known as the second golden generation after Liu Wenyan’s generation.
A decent number of talented individuals had emerged from his generation. Of course, they now seemed weak to Su Yu. People like Huang Teng and Xia Yuwen all came from the same generation.

Su Yu had always been quite curious about Liu Hong and his character technique. Liu Hong had claimed to be the successor of Zhang Ruoling, but Su Yu had never believed that. He had asked Liu Wenyan and the others about that. None of them knew anything about Liu Hong being a student of Zhang Ruoling.
It was unlikely that Zhang Ruoling would keep his successor a secret from Liu Wenyan and the others.
“The inheritance of the multiple character faction will not appear out of nowhere.”

There were several sources if one wanted to learn from the multiple character faction. Nan Wujiang, Yun Chen, Wan Tiansheng, Xia Longwu, and Marquis Xia apart from Liu Wenyan’s line. Of course, there was also the possibility that Liu Hong had learned from a different academy. Just because the multiple character faction had originated from Great Xia did not mean that its teachings could only be found in Great Xia.
Su Yu gazed outside the city and sank into thought.

He wasn’t too bothered about Liu Hong’s deal with the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion. He was more surprised about how Liu Hong had not bothered to put on a disguise despite knowing that this was his city. Yes, Liu Hong had left the city, but was he not worried that he would be captured and taught a lesson?
“Is he trying to lure me out?”
The look in Su Yu’s eyes changed. Was this a plot to lure him out before killing him? That was possible. Liu Hong was most definitely not a good person.

Su Yu turned to look at Grandstar. After a slight hesitation, he decided to forget about getting Grandstar’s help. This guy loved acting tough way too much. If he needed help, he was better off looking for Empyrean Cloud.

He should get Empyrean Cloud to accompany and protect him while he was out of the city. He had to figure out what Liu Hong’s plan was. But if this was a trap, would Empyrean Cloud alone be enough? Then again, he could always summon the old turtle in an emergency.
“Liu Hong…Luminous Domain Mansion…”

Should he capture Liu Hong and enter the mansion disguised as Liu Hong? Su Yu rubbed his chin as he considered that option. Soon, he shook his head again. No, that fellow was a troublemaker with numerous enemies as well. He needed an identity that was less likely to catch anyone’s attention.
It would be even better if he could borrow the identity of someone who wasn’t a human. Even so, Liu Hong wasn’t completely useless to him. As his eyes flickered, Su Yu vanished.
He had decided to look for Liu Hong.
Outside the city.

As Liu Hong moved, he shifted his appearance repeatedly. The five elemental worm planted on him by Topsoil Spirit earlier had long been burned away. Previously, he had merely pretended that he couldn’t find it.
When he was far enough from the city, he took a black mask of the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion and put it on. Not long after, he met the white mask.

He wasted no time and explained while taking a storage ring out, “We need to keep a low profile for some time after this so this will be our final job for now. The five elemental race is not to be trifled with either.”
“No problem.”
When the white mask checked the storage ring and noticed the profit, he smiled, “See you. Watch your back. He doesn’t know me, but he knows you.”
After a slight pause, he added, “Don’t forget me the next time you have a job like this.”
“Sure.”

As the white mask vanished with a flicker, Liu Hong started fleeing again. It was time for him to go into hiding. These resources would suffice for quite a long time. He could probably cultivate straight to the Sunmoon Realm before he had to come out of hiding, right?

Suddenly, a massive palm dropped down from the sky. The powers of numerous characters could be sensed on that palm. Liu Hong’s expression changed as he resisted. But before he could do anything, a unique power rippled through him, throwing him into a daze and scattering his characters.
Then, the palm continued descending.
Looking up at the palm, Liu Hong hurriedly said, “Su Yu, we can always talk this out!”
The large palm sent him flying before wrapping itself around him, crushing him to the point of throwing up.
“Su Yu, I’m here to help you! Don’t misunderstand me! I—”
The grip tightened.

Walking out of the dark, Su Yu said, “My teacher taught me that I don’t need to waste my energy talking to you. I need to beat you up first. I think I’ll trust my teacher’s track record. He has been prevailing over you for many years, after all.”
Liu Hong had fooled a lot of people with his trickery, but he had never prevailed over Bai Feng.

That was mostly because Bai Feng had stuck to a simple principle when dealing with Liu Hong. He would gladly accept any benefit Liu Hong had to offer. When there was no benefit to offer, he would beat Liu Hong up. After the beating, he would pretend it never happened and continued working with Liu Hong.
Bai Feng was not the type to spend any money on his projects. He was both too stingy and poor to do something like that. Su Yu wasn’t surprised that Liu Hong knew it was him before he showed himself.
He had utilized the Soul Expanding Art, something Liu Hong recognized. Furthermore, he was probably the only person who would attack Liu Hong unhesitatingly out here.
“Su Yu, I’m really here to help you. I’m telling the truth—”
Su Yu flicked Liu Hong’s forehead with the finger of his massive palm, throwing Liu Hong into a daze.
A short while later, Empyrean Cloud appeared with a white mask in hand. She smiled, “Too weak. There is no trap around. Don’t tell me this is what you wanted my help with? These small fries?”
The white mask was by no means weak. He was a peak Mountainsea. But he was also nothing before Empyrean Cloud.

Su Yu laughed, “Lord, that was only an excuse for you to take a stroll out here. I need a proper excuse lest Lord Grandstar gets overly jealous, right? I wouldn’t dare to trouble you for a mere Mountainsea. I can deal with such small fries myself.”
Empyrean Cloud smiled with satisfaction.
Nice.

The future of this mayor was bright. Clearly, Su Yu was good at pleasing his superiors. Not bad at all. She had been curious about this. Why did Su Yu waste his time with a mere Mountainsea? In fact, she had been quite displeased earlier. How could he waste the time of an Invincible with a mere Mountainsea? But now, she was feeling great.
She said, “Well done. If you have need of me again, feel free to contact me. I checked. There is no trap here. Shall I…”

Su Yu smiled, “Please go ahead, Lord. Enjoy the stroll. Just remember to come back within three hours. I need to dedicate more time to cultivating for now, so you will have to limit your time outside temporarily.”
Empyrean Cloud smiled again. What a good mayor.
She said, “In that case…I’ll scout further ahead lest there are people plotting against you further away.”
Then, she vanished.
Su Yu smiled respectfully, but he was rolling his eyes inwardly. What a poor excuse. Was she not embarrassed saying such a blatant lie?
He looked at the dazed Liu Hong and the unconscious white mask with a smile. With the two in tow, he vanished.
Mayor’s residence.
Liu Hong woke up in a daze. When he looked ahead, he was greeted with the sight of Su Yu and a cup of tea. There were only the two of them in the massive hall.

His heart thumped as he hurriedly checked his storage ring. When he saw that the ring was still on him, he exhaled in relief. He hurriedly said, “Su Yu, there is no great enmity between us. I actually helped you a lot in Great Xia. Do you still remember the Skybreak Technique? I was the one who had provided that willpower text. I was also aware of the scam you performed on the single character faction, but I had never said anything about it.

“I’m only passing by this city. I did nothing. Why did you attack me for no reason? Strictly speaking, we came from the same line. I am the student of Teacher Zhang Ruoling. We are actually brothers of the same generation…”
Su Yu merely gazed at Liu Hong silently. After a long while, he smiled and offered, “Do you want a drink?”
Liu Hong was naturally not in the mood to drink. He said, “Su Yu, I—”
A hammer descended and knocked him down again.

Su Yu’s voice rang out, “My teacher was right. When dealing with you, I shouldn’t waste my time talking. In truth, I enjoy talking a lot. I love talking sense into people. I am very reasonable. Alas, I also know that ninety percent of my words are lies.”
Su Yu continued sipping tea in a leisurely manner. In short, Liu Hong was the same type of person as him. Strictly speaking, he had actually learned a lot from Liu Hong during his time at Great Xia…
Such as how to smile brightly while doing bad things.
Such as how to lie through his teeth.
Such as…

Su Yu had always believed that he was a good man. A lot of the bad things he had done were things he had learned from the Great Xia Cultural Research Academy. There were too many treacherous schemers there.
And Liu Hong was among the best of them.

With his teacher in seclusion, he was able to do well in the competitive single character faction without any backing. He was someone worth learning from. After some time, Liu Hong regained his consciousness. Just as he opened his mouth to speak, a hammer descended again.
Once again, he lost his consciousness. After some time, he woke up again. But this time, he opted to pretend that he was still unconscious. Alas, the merciless hammer dropped down yet again.
